requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Ensure that only one name/reference is presented to customers for the HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 series on 123.hp.com, to reduce user confusion and errors.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must reliably print on all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media types, meeting intervention specifications for different media and climatic conditions on the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must operate without functional issues when placed on uneven surfaces such as sofas, tablecloths, or carpets, and must not experience input tray sensor flag breakage under these conditions.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Assess functional performance and failure risks if the printer is tilted left or right by 20 degrees during printing.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must maintain print quality and functionality when printing while placed on a moving or stationary trolley.
